text: {"lessons":["I should not let the pleasure of selling winners turn into repeatedly trimming the same stock without checking whether its prospects and portfolio weight still justify holding it.","Buying after a decline can be sensible, but I should make each purchase against a clear valuation and risk plan rather than simply adding because prices look lower.","When the account is falling, holding still deserves an active review: I should reassess the overall portfolio and each position instead of relying on past gains or average cost to guide me."]}
